title: 固定文本 Token 长度

standard.summary: 0 = 动态批内 padding（默认）；>0 = 固定长度（如 512）。固定长度可加速编译优化路径，但会增加 padding 开销。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: 0 means dynamic in-batch padding, the default; a value above 0 means a fixed length such as 512. A fixed length speeds up the compiled path at the cost of more padding.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

advanced.principle: 0 = 动态批内 padding（默认）；>0 = 固定长度（如 512）。固定长度可加速编译优化路径，但会增加 padding 开销。

advanced_en.principle: 0 = dynamic in-batch padding (default); >0 = fixed length (e.g. 512). Fixed length speeds up the compile-optimized path but adds padding overhead.
